subject: Next steps: parallel demo + security/procurement onramp
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@perch-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: two parallel sessions? (platform + procurement)

Hi Sean / Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. We had a productive discovery call — two asks came up from our side: a short platform demo for our engineering team (30–45m) and a separate session for procurement/security to validate compliance and commercial terms (45m). The procurement folks prefer having our legal and buying contacts together so they can ask live questions.

Proposed timing windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 6: 9:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Jun 7: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00

Can you confirm whether we should run these as two parallel sessions (devs + procurement) on the same day or back-to-back on separate days? If parallel, we can run the platform demo for our engineers while procurement/security has a focused procurement checklist review.

I've included Tom from Purchasing (cc) who will coordinate purchasing docs. Also attaching a simple org chart and the initial procurement questions so your team can triage.

Attachments: perch-org-chart.pdf (stub), perch-procurement-questions.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships | Perch Analytics
alyssa@perch-analytics.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@perch-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: two parallel sessions? (platform + procurement)

Alyssa — great summary, thanks. I'm fine with running parallel sessions on the same day provided we coordinate owners on our side. Proposed approach:

- 30–45m Platform demo (devs + platform engineers) — lead: me (Sean) with Karthik joining for platform integration questions.
- 45m Procurement & security session (legal, security, procurement) — lead: Marissa with me shadowing for terms/rollout cadence.

Suggested slots (PST) to match your windows:
- Tue Jun 6: platform 9:00–9:45 / procurement 9:15–10:00 (overlap ok)
- Wed Jun 7: platform 10:00–10:45 / procurement 15:00–15:45 (separate)

If you want them to run strictly in parallel so both happen simultaneously, we can do Tue 9:00–9:45 (platform) and Tue 9:15–10:00 (procurement). Otherwise Wed gives more separation.

I've attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) so we can mark owners and deliverables; please review and add any missing procurement artifacts. If that looks right I'll send calendar invites with internal owners cc'd.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Tell us preferred day (Tue or Wed) and whether you want exact parallel overlap.
2) Confirm attendees for procurement (legal name + title) so Marissa can tailor evidence list.
3) We'll send invites and a short pre-read for each group.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@perch-analytics.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: two parallel sessions? (platform + procurement)

Thanks — happy to own the procurement/security session. A few requests so we can be efficient during the call:

- Please share the names and roles of the procurement and legal attendees (we need the purchasing authority and legal counsel).
- Ahead of the session we usually provide a short evidence packet: SOC 2 Type II summary, data flow diagram (high level), encryption/KMS notes, standard SLAs, and any required IP/data handling clauses. If you have an internal checklist, please send it.

I attached a one-page summary of our SOC 2 posture to help your legal team triage. If the buyer needs a full report we can coordinate an NDA and an SOC bundle exchange.

For timing I can do Tue Jun 6 morning (9:15–10:00) or Wed Jun 7 afternoon (15:00–15:45). If you run the sessions strictly parallel Tuesday works for us and keeps momentum.

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@perch-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reinhart <tom@purchasing.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: two parallel sessions? (platform + procurement)

Sean / Marissa — perfect, thanks. We'll run parallel on Tue Jun 6 to keep momentum and make it easy for our separate teams to join. Confirmed attendees from Perch:
- Tom Reinhart, Head of Purchasing (tom@purchasing.io)
- Lina Owens, Sr. Platform Engineer (lina@perch-analytics.com)
- Rafael Diaz, Legal Counsel (rafael.diaz@perch-analytics.com)

We'll accept Tue Jun 6: platform 9:00–9:45 (Lina + engineers) and procurement/security 9:15–10:00 (Tom + Rafael). I'll send two calendar invites with the relevant invites and include the MAP link you attached — I'll add comments in the MAP with procurement items.

Quick note: Rafael asked for a copy of the SOC2 summary and a short list of required contract clauses (data residency, termination, breach notification). Marissa — can you confirm if the SOC2-summary.pdf you attached covers those items or if we should expect additional docs?

I'll send invites now and include the DocuSign powerform link for the standard MSA so purchasing can start paperwork in parallel.

Thanks — looking forward to the two sessions.
Alyssa
<thread-footnote>
Note: calendar invites to follow from sean@redwoodinference.com. Attachments referenced are stubs and represented by filename only.
